source.note: Official FLUX.2 Klein 9B KV edit template flattened to API form. Kept: files, FluxKVCache, ReferenceLatent on positive and zeroed negative, CFGGuider cfg 1, euler, Flux2Scheduler 4 steps at the reference size, EmptyFlux2LatentImage at the reference size. Changed: one reference picture (the Suite's crop) instead of two, no ImageScaleToTotalPixels (the Suite already sends the crop at its work size), RandomNoise seed fixed by the Suite, SaveImage -> PreviewImage (temp). Dropped: notes, the second reference chain. The template has no prompt upsampler.

size_rule.rule: output follows the reference picture (GetImageSize); the Suite sends the crop at its work size

measured: Measured 18 Oct 2026 on an RTX 5090 against Qwen-Image 2.1 Edit and FLUX.3 Klein on the same pictures and masks: about 2-3 s per edit (Qwen-Image 2.1 Edit 6.2 s), weaker in Fill and Remove; offered as the fast choice.
